verdict.rationale: The evidence only covers configurable logging destinations for proxy input/output (e.g., disabling message/response logging to providers like Langfuse) while noting that spend/metadata tracking still continues regardless; there is no documented setting to disable LiteLLM's own telemetry or usage tracking to the vendor. missing for 10: an explicit telemetry/usage-analytics opt-out flag or env var, documentation confirming no data is sent to LiteLLM's own servers, and any way to fully disable spend/call tracking.
